{{Top}}
[[File:B1scanner-TCWCE.png|thumb|right|A B1 battle droid with a portable scanner]]
'''Portable scanners''' or '''hand-held scanners''' were handheld units that were used as [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] tools for reconnaissance missions and general exploration. They were relatively cheap to buy, but far less powerful than [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] found aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] or vehicles.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

They were used by virtually all colonists and military units for basic scanning purposes. While small and short-ranged, these scanners fulfilled simple needs by incorporating equipment such as motion sensors, metal scanners, comm scanners, and life-form scanners. Other scanners also had equipment to detect [[Droid/Legends|droids]], vehicles, [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]], energy fields, power generators, and other objects. Some scanners were small enough to wear on the belt or around the neck on a strap. Many types of scanners, including those employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], could be attached to [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] or droids for increased analysis.

Many varieties of scanners existed, with varying ranges, sizes and capabilities. The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] were known to have several bizarre organic analogs to portable scanners.
